description_en: Retrieves the execution IDs of Cloud Assistant commands for a task execution
description_zh: 获取任务执行内部的云助手命令执行ID
kebab_example: aliyun oos list-task-execution-invocations --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --status Running --task-execution-id exec-a10749813b3xxxxx.t0001 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListTaskExecutionInvocations

parameters.description_en: The execution status. Valid values: Running, Started, Success, Failed, Waiting, Cancelled, Pending, and Skipped.
parameters.description_zh: 执行状态，取值范围：Running, Started, Success, Failed, Waiting, Cancelled, Pending, Skipped。
